svg.text: T W I N G A B L E S C O U R T Y A R D
A — Balanced wings, compact dressing rooms
PROPOSED 2D LAYOUT / Two primary suites + office / three baths / 2,800 sq ft enclosed, excluding courtyard
Exact 2,800 sq ft enclosed planning area; retains the courtyard reveal and two parallel gable wings. Proposed furnished 2D layout, not rebuilt or
Single-bank walk-ins replace opposing wardrobes: nominal 43.5 in clear aisle, organized storage rather than a closet island.
Secondary suite and support rooms use staggered rear boundaries; kitchen begins behind pantry at y 38 while living begins y 36.
Overall envelope: 60'-0" x 54'-0"; open court: 440 sq ft; enclosed: 2,800 sq ft.
Proposed 2D arrangement for selection; no native model has been rebuilt or engineering confirmed.
CONCEPT DESIGN / Dimensions govern; do not scale. Site, products and engineering unverified.
